title: GraphLoc-300 labels and graph benchmarks
subtitle: Per-instance bug-localization labels and code-graph expansion benchmarks
description:
Companion resource for two writeups submitted to the Google Gemma 4 Developer Agent Paper Track.

(a) graphloc300.jsonl: function-level gold localization labels for all 300 SWE-bench Lite instances with per-instance difficulty labels.
(b) coverage.json, hop_scale.json, hop_profile.json: coverage-vs-budget curves, pool-cap sweeps, hop-distance profiles.
(c) disentangle.json, cross_repo.json, crossover.json: controlled ablations that separate seed-set SIZE from graph-aware ORDERING, and locate the budget at which each configuration wins. These underpin the paper's self-correction: at review budgets of 20-50 the graph-aware ordering is no better than plain BM25, and the usable configuration is budget-dependent.
(d) eval_suite.json, rerank.json, rank_search.json: accuracy@k comparisons plus the reported negative results (learned reranker, seed consensus, PageRank fusion, task triage, unbounded expansion).
(e) adherence.json, e2e_runs.csv: the end-to-end agent run log behind the adherence-gap analysis.
(f) paper1_resource.pdf, paper2_application.pdf: the two arXiv-ready papers with figures.
(g) graphloc_seed_expansion.executed.ipynb: the executed notebook; regenerates every reported number on CPU in under three minutes, no GPU, no LLM, no paid API.
(h) src/ and skill/graph-locate/: full experiment source and a working ADK localization skill.
